currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.42 is merged, deployed, and live-verified. Arrival cards now show full pending order details and all active incomplete tasks assigned to the machine, independently from Today-list task rendering.
releaseScope: Arrival visit cards show pending order type, subtype, full detail text, and remaining/deadline state.
Arrival visit cards show every active incomplete task assigned to that machine, regardless of Today-list decoration.
Arrival task rendering is implemented separately from the Today-list task block.
Unchecked tasks in the visit-completion confirmation remain incomplete exactly as before.
Routing, HGV restrictions, highway/JCT logic, directional reroute, turn zoom, and FINAL.36 detour safety behavior are unchanged.

Do not change routing/HGV/highway/JCT/directional-reroute/turn-zoom behavior in FINAL.42.
Keep AN15 learned numeric promotion intentionally paused and do not restore OCR/Analysis.
